# Feature: API Documentation

## Overview
Create comprehensive API documentation with interactive examples, proper versioning, and developer resources to ensure successful API integration.

## User Stories

1. Interactive Documentation
   - As a developer
   - I want interactive API documentation
   - So that I can test endpoints while learning

2. Code Examples
   - As an integration partner
   - I want code examples in multiple languages
   - So that I can quickly implement integrations

3. SDK Generation
   - As a developer
   - I want to generate client SDKs
   - So that I can easily consume the API

4. Version Management
   - As an API consumer
   - I want clear version documentation
   - So that I can handle API changes properly

5. Developer Portal
   - As an integration partner
   - I want a comprehensive developer portal
   - So that I can find all necessary resources

## Technical Tasks
- [ ] Create OpenAPI specification
- [ ] Implement interactive documentation
- [ ] Build code example generator
- [ ] Create SDK generation pipeline
- [ ] Implement version management
- [ ] Add developer portal
- [ ] Create API playground
- [ ] Implement documentation testing
- [ ] Add changelog automation
- [ ] Create feedback system

## Acceptance Criteria
- Documentation is comprehensive
- Interactive testing works
- Code examples are accurate
- SDKs generate properly
- Versions documented clearly
- Portal functions properly
- Playground works correctly
- Tests verify documentation

## Technical Notes
- Use OpenAPI/Swagger
- Implement proper versioning
- Use documentation generators
- Cache documentation builds
- Follow API standards
- Implement proper testing

## Estimate
- Story Points: 8
- Time Estimate: 1 week

## Dependencies
- All other API features
- Core API implementation
